fields.label: Direction
fields.description: Outward = we dispatch (from = our GSTIN); Inward = we receive

fields.label: From GSTIN Source
fields.description: Dotted path from the document to the dispatch party's GSTIN. e.g. Delivery Challan: from_location.gstin ; GRN: supplier.gstin ; Stock Entry: from_warehouse.supplier.gstin

fields.label: To GSTIN Source
fields.description: Dotted path to the recipient party's GSTIN. e.g. Delivery Challan: supplier.gstin ; GRN: delivery_location.gstin ; Stock Entry: to_warehouse.supplier.gstin

fields.label: Item HSN Source
fields.description: Dotted path from an item row to its HSN code
